molecule_name: Allogeneic TGFBR2 KO CAR27/IL-15-expressing NK Cells

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: These are genetically engineered natural killer (NK) cells designed to target and kill cancer cells. They have been modified to knock out the TGFBR2 gene, express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting a specific cancer antigen, and produce IL-15 to enhance their activity and persistence.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The NK cells are engineered to lack TGFBR2, express CAR27, and secrete IL-15, enhancing their anti-tumor activity.

data_notes.record_scope: The record is focused on the investigational cell therapy Allogeneic TGFBR2 KO CAR27/IL-15-expressing NK Cells, including its mechanism, targets, and clinical development status.
